QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: failsafeMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Specifies the failsafe action applied to ArduPilot vehicles when they connect. Rally Point uses RTL with rally points enabled. RTL Home uses standard RTL. Loiter Hold continues/loiters in place.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: selectedVehicle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Filename (without .json) of the currently selected vehicle from config/vehicles/.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: udpPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UDP port used for the default vehicle connection. Applied to the auto-connect UDP listener on startup.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: checklistEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: If enabled, the selected JSON checklist is active for pre-flight review.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: selectedChecklist
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Filename (without .json) of the currently selected checklist from config/checklists/.
